content: This information does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or suitable for you. It is not intended to replace individualized medical advice and should not substitute for the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. While taking this medication, it is essential to undergo laboratory and/or medical tests, such as pregnancy tests, blood counts/hemoglobin levels, liver, thyroid, or heart function tests, electrocardiograms (EKG), and eye examinations. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed.
